items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played, Bertha, Ron McClure, and myself played a couple – two or three tunes.

ctx.x: The bass player, yeah. We played, Bertha, Ron McClure, and myself played a couple – two or three tunes. Then they had some Japanese people there playing, and they had a Japanese choir singing, and all like that. It was pretty much a Japanese burial thing, but at the end of it – with some jazz added at the end of it. It was nice.
